doc: The seasonal grass palette, one word each — multipliers (green family) and luminance recolors (hue-changers), NORMALIZED against Sol's blade atlas (opaque mean 91/138/35). GREEN is a recolor, not a multiplier: a species whose sheet is authored another hue (galleta's straw) can only be brought BACK to green by discarding hue and re-tinting; its value reproduces the blade atlas's own mean green from its luminance. Underscore file = domain sidecar, not a species (loadDomain skips it).
